question:

I. National Statistics Day (June 29) is observed to commemorate the birth anniversary of Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis, with the 2026 theme being 'Unlocking the Potential of Administrative Data'.
II. International Asteroid Day (June 30) marks the anniversary of the Tunguska asteroid impact in 1908.
III. World Zoonoses Day (July 6) commemorates Louis Pasteur administering the first human rabies vaccine in 1885.
